notes.title: Update! Long-awaited Achievements Are Now in the Game!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

In the latest game update, we’ve added a variety of improvements, but the main event is the long-awaited achievements! We know you've been waiting for this moment, and we’ve finally made it happen. There are 10 achievements available, and we hope you enjoy unlocking them!

For developers using Godot Engine who are still figuring out how to add achievements and are looking for a solution, we have good news: you can use the GodotSteam addon. It works with both versions 3 and 4 and offers a lot of additional features. Thanks to the developers!

notes.title: New features and improvements in the latest game update!
notes.notes:
In the latest update, we've added new features to make the gameplay even more convenient and enjoyable. Now you can speed up your character's walking speed with a double click and automatically pause the game when the window is minimized. In version 1.0.292, we've addressed some issues with the pause feature, which now also includes a timer for the dialogue window and music.

In the game settings, we've made the following improvements:

[list]
[*] Increased the window size and improved its design for better readability and capacity.
[*] Added a separate volume control for the music compared to other sounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where sound would continue to play even at minimum volume.
[*] Added the ability to switch settings using the more convenient left and right arrows.
[/list]

Additionally, we've fixed many minor bugs, such as changing the position of the close button to the top right corner and design changes.

Enjoy playing and have a great day, friends!

notes.title: Mechanic 8230 in Brazilian Portuguese!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! We hope you're doing well and are ready to hear the news about our game. A year ago, we released the first episode and are happy to announce that we're working hard on the second.

Our game is already localized in five languages: Russian, English, Chinese, German, and now, thanks to Aleff Lourenço, in Brazilian Portuguese. Thank you, Aleff! We would like to thank the dedicated and passionate individuals from these countries for their help in translating our game, which was created free of charge. We would also like to apologize for not being able to add achievements and fix inconveniences with interactive elements that need to be approached.

The plot of the second episode is a direct continuation of the first. The events will now take place on the Cititon space station, where we will have to uncover many secrets. We will also meet new characters who will shed light on many things that were previously unclear.

This time, we will focus on RO-2, which will allow us to better reveal this enigmatic robot and delve deeper into its world.

The rusty, post-apocalyptic setting wrapped in wires still remains.

We also continue to work in the Godot game engine and are very happy with this choice. But we also use other open-source tools, such as Blender, Krita, and Gimp.

Unfortunately, we cannot say for sure when the game will be released, but the creation of the second episode is going faster thanks to our accumulated experience. We hope you continue to look forward to the continuation of our game and thank you for your support. See you soon!
